notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/2783784e0597737098de48f6786085526947f8f6.png[/img]

It has been just over a week since the finals, and we have more updates!

Now you can see the goals scored in the France-Argentina match, Edison Cavani's goal in a match against Japan or a beautiful action that secured the Belgians to the 1/4 finals. In addition, repetitions from semi-final matches have been added.
 It's not everything! We placed one of the goals of the France - Croatia final match.

Check out the news in Turbo Soccer VR!

notes.title: New update - Patch #1
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/ce1d84241e2ef4f3574e8fc3ed119e2bfdd24b5f.jpg[/img]

[h1]The most important stage of the World Cup is coming up![/h1]

The final phase, with grand finale in Moscow on June 15th has already begun. Unfortunately, the Polish national team had to say goodbye to the tournament, but our support for the team will last nevertheless.

Specifically for the knock-out stage we have prepared an update giving you the opportunity to play as players competing in the World Cup, who scored wonderful goals. 

Additionally, we have introduced smaller adjustments, which improved the looks and performance of the game.

[h1]New version of Turbo Soccer VR contains:[/h1]

5 replays from the first round of the World Cup:

[b]Russia vs. Saudi Arabia - 12th minute of the game[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/bdcaf5a4c20aa5e19cb22cf637599545dec72780.jpg[/img]

[b]Portugal vs. Spain - 88th minute of the game[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/f6c5cbe6b9e6ee59b6846b77074ba776fa159411.jpg[/img]

[b]Peru vs. Denmark - 59th minute of the game[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/8a6993873587fb0c1d6354fb6f64eb9d946c64fa.jpg[/img]

[b]Brazil vs. Switzerland - 20th minute of the game[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/ee276b9259aa4b22af2a22758e0118f27f264482.jpg[/img]

[b]Germany vs. Mexico - 30th minute of the game[/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32827196/c518aee8b002be541e368a74fa950f7aa4a5f6c5.jpg[/img]

Additionally:
[list]
[*]new replay menu with a notification tab informing about the match from which the replay has been taken;
[*]improved gameplay;
[*]optimized performance.
[/list]

Thank you for the warm welcome you have given to Turbo Soccer VR. Next week we will be releasing a new update introducing replays taken from the next matches from the World Cup in Russia.
